source.title: IEEE Std 1609.2a-2017, Amendment 1 to IEEE Std 1609.2-2016, Annex D.6 "Cryptographic test vectors"
source.licence: IEEE copyright, no redistribution licence: values transcribed with citations, document not vendored
source.method: tools/oracle/transcribe/transcribe.py from a text extraction of the PDF; every value cross-checked against the C-array repeat printed beside it in the standard

parameters: IEEE 1609.2a section 5.3.5: ECIES over NIST P-256, non-DHAES, KDF2 with SHA-256 (K = KDF2(x(v*R), 48, P1)), K1 = K[0:16] XOR-wraps the 16-byte AES key, K2 = K[16:48], T = MAC1 = leftmost 16 bytes of HMAC-SHA-256(K2, C), P2 empty
erratum: The printed P1 of every D.6.2 vector equals the AES key k (16 bytes): a print bug in the generator (CAMP ecies.py prints k on the P1 line). in.p1 is the real 32-byte P1 that the generator used (CAMP ecies.py p11/p12). With in.p1, C and T reproduce; with p1_printed they must not (docs/design/scms-real/02-cryptography-and-formats.md section 8.2).
